Wide shot over a silver ocean with sea stacks: a brown pelican with wings spread wide glides low over the waves, free, golden light breaking through the mist. Far behind on the shore, tiny HANK and DOUG watch from the rocks.

Medium two-shot at golden sunset on the bluff: HANK and DOUG sit side by side on the bench of WAGON, looking at each other, the sea and sea stacks glowing orange behind them. Both faces clearly visible in three-quarter view.
